Genuine intra-file arithmetic contradiction, verified verbatim. 07.06.01-session-record-attendance.md:153 states 'Activity resuming within **6h** of the last activity **re-opens the same session**. Beyond 6h it is a new session', while :154 states 'Auto-closed session resumes at hour 13 | Reopens (within the 6h window) and un-closes.' Auto-close only fires after 12h of inactivity (:152), so a resume at hour 13 cannot be 'within the 6h window'; the row and the rule cannot both hold and neither carries a marker. Overstated in one respect and downgraded accordingly: the 30-minute figure at 07.06.02-session-close-capture-prompt.md:148 is a separate mechanism (undoing a mistaken *manual* close, per D-16 at :227), not a third inactivity threshold, so the surviving defect is the single broken edge-case row, not an incoherent window set.
